chunks: Build the ark under Our eye and Our instruction, and do not plead with Me for those who have been wicked, for they shall certainly be drowned.
ai.seo_question: What did Allah command Prophet Noah regarding the construction of the ark and the fate of the wicked?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'with Our eyes and Our revelation' (bi-a'yunina wa wahyina) highlights the dual nature of divine guidance, where Noah received both direct revelation for the technical specifications and constant divine surveillance for accuracy. This verse underscores the transition from Noah's intercession for his people to the finality of divine decree, marking the ark as a symbol of salvation for the believers amidst the destruction of the unjust.
